nodes.label: Unit tests for HilbertProcessingWriter — BrainVision output path.  Covers: -
Build a minimal HilbertProcessingResult with synthetic data.
Annotations carried in the result are written to the output .vmrk.
A source-rate -1 sample shift is not equivalent to a 100 Hz -1 shift.
Exact TSV onsets must not be snapped to source samples before projection.
SPM2ENV event export follows SPM's 1-based continuous sample logic.
